description:
The Mackenzie Panel Back Crib offers a beautiful alternative to the slat design, featuring a solid raised panel headboard that adds warmth and a cozy feel to your nursery. This 4-in-1 convertible crib is crafted from solid hardwood in a rich Brown Maple finish and transitions from crib to toddler bed, daybed, and full-size (double) bed as your child grows.

Three adjustable mattress height settings provide flexibility and safety from newborn to toddler. Finished with non-toxic, baby-safe materials that exceed CPSC and ASTM safety standards. Perfect for pairing with the slat back crib in a shared space or mixing and matching with the complete Mackenzie collection.

If you would like help choosing a finish, confirming timing, or picturing how this piece fits your nursery plans, use Get Personal Assistance. We reply the same or next business day so you can decide with full information, at your own pace.
